stories.title: From No. 1 to ... Cleveland: Solak ranks all 32 NFL teams by watchability
stories.summary: Which NFL teams are must-watches every Sunday? We stacked all 32 by excitement, fun and intrigue, starting with Chicago.

stories.title: NFL axing Pro Bowl Games, will still honor players
stories.summary: The NFL is eliminating the Pro Bowl Games, instead shifting the focus to celebrating the honor of being a Pro Bowl selection.

stories.title: PCA, Cubs fume after umps' miss: 'Get it right'
stories.summary: The Cubs and star outfielder Pete Crow-Armstrong were left fuming Wednesday after umpires missed a pivotal balk call in what ended up being a 2-0 Chicago loss to the Arizona Diamondbacks in Phoenix.

stories.title: NFL signs new deals with trio of sportsbooks
stories.summary: The NFL has reached multiyear partnerships with DraftKings, FanDuel and Fanatics for those sportsbooks to be official betting operators of the league.

stories.title: Sources: Liverpool reach $163M deal for Barcola
stories.summary: Liverpool are closing in on a deal to sign Paris Saint-Germain forward Bradley Barcola, sources told ESPN.
